cases.note: A tool field's default is the string the input schema advertises to the model: one quoted string, whose text is a literal of the field's type (memql#5430). The quotes are the form; what is inside them is held to the type at load -- see the refusals below.
The text of a boolean field's default is true or false, and the schema publishes it as a boolean.
A field that declares its values takes one of them as its default.

cases.note: memql#5430: the text inside the quotes was never checked, so the model was told the integer field defaults to "twenty" and a call that left it out handed the handler the string.
